kaikki_vikisozluk.e: خَفِيف الدَّمِ • (ḵafīf ad-dami) (feminine خَفِيفة الدَّمِ (ḵafīfat ad-dami))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally: “light-blooded”. Compare semantically dated German leichtblütig with the same sense. Probably based on the concepts of humoral medicine.
g: funny, light-hearted, amusing, good at making jokes and entertaining people
